title: Dependency Risk Caveat Scope v1
description: Machine-readable artifact that scopes a dependency-risk caveat for assessment interpretation. It deliberately does NOT remediate the risk and does NOT grant security/production readiness or a result_assessment. It records scope_status, whether the risk was remediated, whether result_assessment/comparison are allowed after scoping, an audit observation, an assessment interpretation, and an anti-overclaim does_not_establish boundary. Form is validated here; semantic rules (scoped_not_remediated coupling, audit-exit coupling, remediated-requires-evidence, mandatory does_not_establish, source-evidence existence/escape, challenge_version existence) are enforced by scripts/docmeta/validate_dependency_risk_caveat_scope.py.

scope_status.$comment: Semantic rules: 'scoped_not_remediated' requires dependency_risk_remediated=false, security/production readiness 'blocked', result_assessment_allowed_after_scope=false, comparison_ready_after_scope=false, and the matching assessment_interpretation strings. 'remediated' (or dependency_risk_remediated=true) requires a non-empty remediation_evidence list whose paths exist.

audit_exit_code.$comment: A non-zero integer is semantically coupled (validator) to dependency_risk_remediated=false and blocked security/production readiness.

comparison_ready.$comment: String, not boolean. Under scope_status=scoped_not_remediated the validator requires the literal string 'false'.

does_not_establish.$comment: Mandatory anti-overclaim list. Must include the baseline non-claims enforced by the validator: security_readiness, production_readiness, absence_of_vulnerabilities, dependency_risk_remediated, dependency_tree_safe, supply_chain_safety, production_dependency_health, security_approval, model_quality, comparative_superiority, condition_effect, outcome_upgrade, adoption_readiness, promotion_readiness.

remediation_evidence.$comment: Required (non-empty, existing paths) only when scope_status=remediated or dependency_risk_remediated=true; enforced semantically by the validator.

repoRelativePath.$comment: Repo-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes are rejected here; parent-escape ('..') and symlink-out-of-repo are rejected semantically by the validator with a stable rule id.
